name: Landing page (initial load)
comment: Next.js runtime + React + critical app code. Recharts and XLSX must be dynamically imported.

name: Recharts bundle (dashboard only)
comment: Recharts + D3 deps. Loaded only on /dashboard routes.

name: XLSX/exceljs bundle (import only)

name: CSS bundle (all pages)
comment: Tailwind JIT + component styles. tokens.css + globals.css combined.

name: Font files (combined)
comment: Cormorant Garamond (400, 600) + DM Sans (400, 500) — subsetted to Latin.
